scopes.api:crm:schema: Upload CRM schema fields to Gong.
scopes.api:crm:upload: Upload a CRM data file to Gong.
scopes.api:users:read: Retrieve user data such as ID, name, and phone number.
scopes.api:library:read: Retrieve Library folders details such as ID, name, last updated by and a list of calls in it.
scopes.api:workspaces:read: Retrieve a list of all workspaces.
scopes.api:calls:read:basic: Retrieve basic call data such as title, duration, and spoken language.
scopes.api:stats:scorecards: Retrieve scorecard statistics such as name, matching call ID, and a list of scorecard's answers.
scopes.api:data-privacy:read: Retrieve a list of all references to either a specific email address or phone call.
scopes.api:provisioning:read: Auto provision users and groups using SCIM protocol - Read Only.
scopes.api:stats:interaction: Retrieve user interaction statistics including various metrics such as `Talk Ratio` and `Interactivity`.
scopes.api:stats:user-actions: Retrieve user action statistics, such as number of feedback requests or number of call shares.
scopes.api:data-privacy:delete: Delete all references to a given email address or phone call.
scopes.api:calls:read:extensive: Retrieve basic call data such as title, duration, and spoken language, and extended data such as interaction stats, list of speakers, and main topics of conversation.
scopes.api:calls:read:media-url: Retrieve a URL that can be used to play and download the call media (audio or video). CAUTION: The call media may contain PII and biometric data that should be handled according to the respective data protection & privacy laws and agreements you are bound to.
scopes.api:engagement-data:write: Send user engagement data events to Gong.
scopes.api:provisioning:read-write: Auto provision users and groups using SCIM protocol.
scopes.api:settings:scorecards:read: Retrieve scorecard details such as ID, name, and status (enabled/disabled).
scopes.api:meetings:integration:status: Validate the integration status for managing meetings with Gong.
scopes.api:stats:user-actions:detailed: Retrieve detailed user action statistics, such as a list of feedback requests or number of call shares.
scopes.api:crm-calls:manual-association:read: Read calls that were manually associated with CRM data.
